mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility lifts weekday cross-shopping and nearby lunch traffic, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks because the latest week shows a sharp worksite recovery from the prior dip.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -44.7 to -37.3 while TRANSIT improved from -31.3 to -25.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain flat or worsen over the next 4 weeks while RETAIL_REC still rises versus the last 4 weeks, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility stays elevated and GROCERY_PHARM remains depressed, households consolidate errands into fewer local trips and substitute away from discretionary shopping, making RETAIL_REC fall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -20 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +5
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 5.1 and GROCERY_PHARM was -18.6 in t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays below -20 with RESIDENTIAL above +5 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior two weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A broad transit recovery above the recent trough increases access to retail corridors and suburban-linked shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should be higher within one week after TRANSIT crosses back above -28.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -28 after being below -30
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -31.3 to -25.0 in t-0w while RETAIL_REC improved from -37.7 to -33.9
failure_condition: If TRANSIT crosses above -28 and RETAIL_REC is not higher in the following week, this causal claim is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A late-summer parks surge diverts discretionary time away from indoor retail, so a concurrent rise in PARKS above its recent average predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 8 after two sub-7 weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was 9.4 in t-0w after 6.6 in t-1w and 5.7 in t-2w
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above 8 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not weaken versus the last four weeks, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in WORKPLACES below the recent month average reduces weekday demand spillovers to nearby stores, so RETAIL_REC should fall over the next four weeks when work mobility rolls over again.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -40 after a weekly gain
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -44.7 to -37.3 in t-0w but remains far below baseline
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES falls below -40 again and RETAIL_REC still rises over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve together, commuters have more reasons to make in-person purchases on the same trip chain, so RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:Both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved in t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC does not rise over the following two weeks, reject the mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rebounds sharply while RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated, the pattern indicates more local errand substitution and less discretionary shopping travel, which should push RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 4 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL stays above +5
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -24.1 to -18.6 while RESIDENTIAL stayed positive at 5.1
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM jumps by at least 4 points with RESIDENTIAL above +5 and RETAIL_REC does not decline in the next week, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A post-holiday normalization in PARKS combined with weaker TRANSIT indicates fewer leisure and commute trips, so RETAIL_REC should be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS remains positive but volatile while TRANSIT is still negative
failure_condition: If PARKS and TRANSIT both stabilize or improve and RETAIL_REC nevertheless rises over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.
